en.answer:
Ⓐ: Yes, you can.

en.question:
Can I Special Summon <<20471>> from my Extra Deck using the『by sending the correct Fusion Material Monster Cards you control to the Graveyard』procedure, using:

Ⓐ: A monster whose original Type is Plant, but whose type was changed to Spellcaster by a card effect?
Ⓑ: A monster whose original Type is Spellcaster, but whose type was changed to Plant by a card effect?
en.title: Can I Special Summon <<20471>> using a monster whose Type has been changed?

ja.answer:
（A）できます。

（B）できません。

「<<20423>>」を特殊召喚する際に悪魔族モンスターカードを使用する場合も同様です。
